payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Astrid, Gillian, Reanna, Stefania

payload.content: I have a strong skill in security and moderate availability (8 hours). I see several tasks related to security on ISSUE-0002 with medium priority and reasonable costs. Given my skills, I would be interested in picking either ISSUE-0002::implement, ISSUE-0002::review, or ISSUE-0002::test. I would prefer to take the implement task if no one else strongly claims it, as it has the highest effort but also aligns well with my skills. Are any other agents targeting ISSUE-0002 tasks? Please share your preferences so we can avoid conflicts.

I also want to highlight that the ISSUE-0001 tasks are very high priority but have very high costs for me, especially the implement and review tasks. I would prefer to focus on ISSUE-0002 tasks where my skills match better and costs are more manageable. If anyone else is considering ISSUE-0002 tasks, please coordinate so we maximize task completions without overlaps.
